Indian women's recurve archery team wins historic gold at Asian Games 2026

At the 2026 Asian Games, India's women's recurve archery team won its first-ever gold medal, with team members Ankita, Kirti and Kumkum, while the men's and mixed recurve teams each secured silver; overall India has earned seven archery medals - four gold, two silver and one bronze.
